contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANS [--] ; R/ GLORI A EXER ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constans (333-350), Gloria Exercitus issue of 336-340, Trier mint, Reece period 17; chipped. Obverse description: Youthful bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANS [--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them, M appears on the vexillum . Reverse inscription: GLORI A EXER ITVS. In exergue: TRP. Diameter: 16.1mm, Weight: 1.03gms, die axis: 12
